newsitem.title: USA: Cyclical investors bullish on RPM - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Cyclical investors bullish on RPM - NYT.

text.p: Bullish investors advocate buying stock in RPM Inc, a holding company in Medina, Ohio, according to a story in the Sunday edition of the New York Times.
RPM, referred to in the story as an all-weather stock, produces 100 coatings, sealants and specialty chemicals for industry, and for the hobby and do-it-yourself markets.

Jerry Herman, who follows midsized growth companies at Everen Securities in Cleveland is quoted in the story as saying the stock does quite well within a late cycle-early recession time frame. In 1990, Herman says, the stock was up 22 percent, 15 percent in 1991 and 32 percent in 1992.
Bullish investors see RPM stock as underpriced, pointing to the company's recent hard times as well as to stepped-up management incentives and its overseas expansion plans, the Times article says.
The company has been hurt by the recent slowdown in consumer spending and by the severity of the last winter, the article says.
